gloss: to dig up; to unearth; to excavate

definitions.gloss: to dig up; to unearth; to excavate
definitions.explanation: Physically digging something out of the ground.

definitions.gloss: to discover; to find (something valuable or rare); to uncover
definitions.explanation: Figuratively finding something hidden or overlooked, such as a bargain, talent, or rare item.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig) and ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take out). The literal sense refers to physically digging something from the ground. The figurative sense of discovering something valuable is very common, especially in the compound ⟦{掘|ほ}り{出|だ}し{物|もの}→掘り出し物：14746_horidashimono⟧ (a great find, a bargain).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{掘|ほ}り{出|だ}し{物|もの}→掘り出し物：14746_horidashimono⟧: a lucky find, a bargain
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掘|ほ}り{出|だ}す: to discover talent
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{掘|ほ}り{出|だ}す: to excavate from ruins

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart would use ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: {掘|ほ}り{出|だ}す (to dig out) vs. simply ⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧ (to come out).
